Senses.Explanation: In the inherited guest-dust image, ‘guest’ and ‘dust’ name transient troubles or stain that arrive and depart rather than the host. Literally, “guest-dust”: dust characterized as a visitor rather than the host. Much of the corpus preserves it in the inherited compound “guest-dust troubles” (客塵煩惱), something said to stain, cover, or be unrecognized. Baizhang Huaihai's distinct functional classification is separated into the Baizhang-specific sense below. Elsewhere the Records say a grown child learns explanations and does not know that these are “guest-dust troubles” (不知是客塵煩惱); Dahui speaks of the “stain of guest-dust troubles since beginningless time” (無始時來客塵煩惱之染); and the Admonitions for the Monastic Gate has the compact bodily compound “body-and-mind guest-dust” (身心客塵). The Zen record therefore keeps the inherited dust imagery while Baizhang bends the compound into an explicit ruler/function classification.
Senses.Note: The corpus-wide sense remains one article because the Baizhang classification depends on the same guest-versus-ruler morphology as the broader compound. The explanation describes the recorded classification without adding an outside account of affliction or purity.

Occurrences.Kwic: 不知是客塵煩惱。十六行中嬰兒行為最。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (景德傳燈錄). Full six-rung exact-turn review identifies Shishi Shandao as the exact headword-bearing speaker, author, or grammatical actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 當淨意根下無始時來客塵煩惱之染。如虛空之寬曠。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (大慧普覺禪師語錄). Dahui's Recorded Sayings, instruction to layman Li; guest-dust troubles occur with the explicit predicate “stain.” The exact headword-bearing actor is Dahui Zonggao.

Occurrences.Kwic: 身心客塵透漏無門。迷悟且說逆順休論。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Admonitions for the Monastic Gate (緇門警訓), in the explicitly headed Inscription on Sitting Chan by Chan Master Foyan Yuan of Longmen (龍門佛眼遠禪師坐禪銘). Foyan Qingyuan is the exact author of the inscription line that says body-and-mind guest-dust has no gate through which to leak.

Occurrences.Kwic: 答。持世經云。菩薩觀心。心中無心相。是心從本以來。不生不起。性常清淨。客塵煩惱染。故有分別。心不知心。亦不見心。何以故。是心空。性自空。故根本無所有。是心無有一定法。定法不可得故。是心
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (宗鏡錄). The answer explicitly quotes the Scripture on Maintaining the Age; Yongming Yanshou is the later quoter.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The answer introduces the clause with 持世經云 ('the Scripture on Maintaining the Age says'), which opens the scripture-quotation boundary containing 客塵煩惱染; Yongming Yanshou records the quotation as later quoter rather than uttering the quoted headword himself.

Senses.Explanation: Baizhang Huaihai uses guest and dust as terms in a functional host-and-guest classification of illuminating activity. This is Baizhang Huaihai-specific classification, not the same referent as transient dust or stain. The entry reports his predicates without generalizing them beyond the anchored passages.
Senses.Note: The corpus-wide sense remains one article because the Baizhang classification depends on the same guest-versus-ruler morphology as the broader compound. The explanation describes the recorded classification without adding an outside account of affliction or purity.
